title: Total distance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute the total path length AD + DE using the Pythagorean theorem for AD.

title: Displacement magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute the straight-line distance AE using the Pythagorean theorem with AC and (CD+DE).

title: Police travel distance
description: Important Criteria: Student must identify that the police travel distance is BE, requiring the Pythagorean theorem with BC and CE.

title: Time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute the interception time using the police distance and given speed, with proper unit conversion.

title: Geometry recognition
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that points C, D, E are collinear and that CD is perpendicular to AB, enabling right triangles.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student maintains consistent units (km, h, s) throughout calculations and conversions.

title: Incorrect triangle selection
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses wrong triangle sides (e.g., uses CD instead of CE for police distance, or misidentifies AD components).

title: Speed conversion error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student fails to convert police speed from km/h to appropriate units for time calculation in seconds.
